unit: Geometry · Chapter VIII. Coordinates and vectors

stages.headline: To find the angle between a and b, lay them off from one point O; the angle between the rays is the angle between the vectors, from 0° to 180°.
stages.headlineEnglish: To find the angle between a and b, lay them off from one point O; the angle between the rays is the angle between the vectors, from 0° to 180°.

stages.headline: Codirectional vectors make 0°, opposite ones 180°; vectors at 90° are called perpendicular.
stages.headlineEnglish: Codirectional vectors make 0°, opposite ones 180°; vectors at 90° are called perpendicular.

stages.headline: Careful: in equilateral ABC the angle between AB and AC is 60°, but between AB and BC it is 120°, since BC must be laid off from A.
